subject: Promote post-reset semantic absorption into a reusable ResourceGraph/BonfyreFS compaction macro

body.observed_result: Claude preserved non-reproducible Run6 state, absorbed unique commits into live git refs, verified remotes/patches/blobs, then deleted 3,134,361,029 bytes with zero refusals and raised free space from 2.8 to 6.5 GiB.
promotion_rule: Classify candidate bytes into remote-reproducible, git-object-preservable, content-addressed-unique, active-live, and unproven-unique before deletion.
Preserve only the non-reproducible delta: local-only commits/stashes/untracked/plain authored bytes. Do not freeze entire reproducible checkouts.
Verify preservation receipt immediately before promotion, then delete source and emit one bounded batched/Merkle proof per semantic root.
Feed measured reclaimed_bytes, unique_bytes_preserved, proof_bytes, verification_seconds and post-delete free space into ResourceGraph learning.
Use this macro on remaining archive/history candidates instead of filename heuristics.
body.next_candidate: The retained ~589 MB raw Bonfÿre archive corpus is explicitly unique evidence. Do not delete it from sampling. If capacity permits, stream every member into BonfyreFS/ObjectFabric content-addressed storage, use Zstd only when net-positive, build a complete manifest/recovery proof, exact-verify, then delete the raw split archives only if the new representation is independently recoverable.
body.admission_after_reclaim: Use effective predicted reserve, not the headline 6.5 GiB. Admit more work only while predicted post-epoch free space stays above emergency reserve plus proof/checkpoint margin.
